info.name: Project Management APIs (v4)
info.description:
Project Management API: compact test suite (about 170 requests) for the current code.
Before you start: edit admin_email and admin_password in the collection variables (a user with the 'Super Admin' profile). Run the server (python manage.py runserver) and make sure the default Profiles and Lookup values exist.
Run the whole collection in order (Runner), or folder by folder:
1 Auth. 2 Setup: creates a Manager, a second Manager, a Team Leader, a Developer and a Client, then logs each in. 3 Users. 4 Profiles. 5 Lookups (project type, project status, task status). 6 Projects. 7 Tasks. 8 Comments. 9 Access: checks that each role sees only its own data. 10 Cleanup (optional): hard-deletes the test projects.
Ids and tokens are saved automatically. Re-runs are fine: users and lookup values that already exist give 400 (accepted), titles use {{$timestamp}}.
File upload: tick the disabled file row in 'Create Project - With File'.
Throttle: 60/min anonymous, 300/min logged in. Swagger: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/docs/
